newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BTR Nylex A$200 mln issue priced at 40 bp over.
newsitem.headline: BTR Nylex A$200 mln issue priced at 40 bp over.

text.p: BTR Nylex's A$200 million debt issue has been priced at 40 basis points over the July 2000 govrenment bond, co-lead manager Westpac Banking Corp said.
The bonds, which mature on July 15, 2000, were priced to yield 6.775 percent and carry a coupon of 6.50 percent.
The pricing comes at the top end of an expected 37 to 41 basis point margin range.
The deal, announced on Tuesday, was issued off BTR Nylex's recently establised A$500 million Medium Term Note programme.
Commonwealth Bank of Australia is the other co-lead manager, while National Australia Bank and ANZ Bank are co-managers.
The notes carry a long term debt rating of A-plus from Standard & Poor's Corp.
The issuer is a wholly-owned subsidiary of BTR Plc
